abstract: A case of 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis with a type III Teter's gonocytoma occurred in the left ovary of a 22-year-old woman. Hormonal, genetic and laparoscopic studies were performed before the diagnosis of gonadal dysgenesis was made. Gonadal neoplasm was found after bilateral gonadectomy.
abstract_ja: 22歳女性の左卵巣に、46,XY性腺異形成症とTeter分類III型の性腺細胞腫が発生した。性腺異形成症の診断前に、ホルモン検査、遺伝学的検査、腹腔鏡検査が行われた。両側性腺摘出術後に性腺腫瘍が発見された。
